maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from QuickBooks subscriptions, TurboTax, Credit Karma and Mailchimp software and services, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by small businesses, consumers and accountants for QuickBooks, TurboTax and Mailchimp; Credit Karma is paid by financial partners.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from selling QuickBooks, TurboTax and Credit Karma products; Credit Karma and Mailchimp were only occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: QuickBooks holds small businesses' books, payroll and invoicing; switching means data migration, retraining and accountant workflow disruption.
